name: Herm's Inn (Logan, UT) "Jim's Hot Cereal" Steel-Cut Oats with Banana & Brown Sugar
whyItWorks: Warm soluble fiber (beta-glucan) from well-cooked steel-cut oats helps form stool without mechanical scratching. Banana provides easy-to-absorb potassium.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order Jim's Hot Cereal with sliced bananas and brown sugar (request no nuts or dried cranberries).
watchOuts: Hold nuts and dried fruit to prevent stricture irritation
